(R. Göbel). For a cardinal number µ, let
               Z<µ = {f ∈ Zµ | |supp (f )| < µ}     and    Gµ = Zµ /Z<µ .
     a) Find a non-zero direct summand D of Gω1 such that D ∼    ̸ Gω1 .
                                                                  =
     b) Investigate the structure of Gµ (the structure of Gω0 is well known).
